crossRefs.note: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

people.name: Bela
people.line: Son of Benjamin, head of the Belaite clan

people.name: Gera
people.line: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
